title: 追進度不惹人厭
subtitle: 12 句英文，催人也不傷感情

lines.say: Hi Arjun. The report? Where is it? I asked you last week! And on Monday! And yesterday!
lines.zh: 嗨 Arjun。報告呢？在哪裡？我上週就問了！星期一也問！昨天也問！

lines.say: Wow. OK. Good morning to you too.
lines.zh: 哇，好喔，你也早安啊。

lines.say: I really needed that report. But after that morning, Arjun didn't speak to me for a week, and the report came even later.
lines.zh: 我真的很需要那份報告。但那天早上之後，Arjun 一週沒跟我說話，報告也更晚才來。

lines.say: Chasing people is a skill. Push too little, nothing happens. Push too hard, you lose a friend.
lines.zh: 追進度是一門技巧。推太輕，什麼都不會發生；推太用力，你會失去一個朋友。

board.cta: 追進度不惹人厭・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences for getting things done through other people.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教你透過別人把事情完成的十二句話。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences for getting things done through other people.

lines.say: A friendly first reminder, a firmer second one, and how to offer help instead of pressure.
lines.zh: 友善的第一次提醒、更堅定的第二次，還有怎麼用幫忙代替施壓。

scenes.title: Friendly nudge
scenes.sub: 第一次提醒：輕輕推一下

lines.say: Part one: the friendly nudge.
lines.zh: 第一段：輕輕推一下。

lines.say: A nudge is a small, gentle push. The first reminder should feel like one.
lines.zh: nudge 是輕輕一推，第一次提醒就該是這種感覺。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: Just checking in on the report. How's it going?
scenes.meaning: 只是來問一下報告，進行得怎麼樣？
scenes.note: check in on ＝ 關心一下進度

lines.say: Just checking in on the report. How's it going?
Check in on means ask about something in a friendly way.
lines.zh: check in on 是友善地關心一下。

lines.say: How's it going is an open question. It lets them tell you about a problem, if there is one.
lines.zh: How's it going 是開放式問題，如果有問題，對方會告訴你。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Just checking in on the report. How's it going?

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: No rush, but do you have a rough idea of when it'll be ready?
scenes.meaning: 不急，但你大概知道什麼時候會好嗎？
scenes.note: a rough idea ＝ 大概的想法

lines.say: Then ask for a time, softly.
lines.zh: 接著溫和地問時間。

lines.say: No rush, but do you have a rough idea of when it'll be ready?
A rough idea means an approximate answer. Not exact, just roughly.
lines.zh: a rough idea 是大概，不用很精確。

lines.say: No rush is only true if it's true! Don't say it on deadline day.
lines.zh: 只有真的不急才能說 no rush！截止日當天不要說。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: No rush, but do you have a rough idea of when it'll be ready?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Is there anything you're waiting on from me?
scenes.meaning: 你有在等我這邊的什麼東西嗎？
scenes.note: wait on ＝ 等待（某人提供）

lines.say: And check that the delay isn't actually you!
lines.zh: 再確認一下，卡住的人其實不是你！

lines.say: Is there anything you're waiting on from me?
Wait on means need something before you can continue.
lines.zh: wait on 是要先拿到某樣東西才能繼續。

lines.say: Sometimes the answer is yes. That's embarrassing, but much better to know.
lines.zh: 有時候答案是有。很尷尬，但知道總比不知道好。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Is there anything you're waiting on from me?

scenes.title: Second reminder
scenes.sub: 第二次提醒：說清楚影響

lines.say: Part two: the second reminder.
lines.zh: 第二段：第二次提醒。

lines.say: The nudge didn't work. Now be clearer, but still kind. Talk about why it matters.
lines.zh: 輕推沒有用。現在要講得更清楚，但還是要友善。說明為什麼重要。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: Sorry to chase, but I'm a bit stuck without it.
scenes.meaning: 抱歉一直催，但沒有它我有點卡住

lines.say: Sorry to chase, but I'm a bit stuck without it.
Sorry to chase recognises that reminding is annoying. That makes it less annoying!
lines.zh: Sorry to chase 承認催人很煩，這反而讓它沒那麼煩！

lines.say: I'm stuck explains the effect on you, not their failure.
lines.zh: I'm stuck 講的是對你的影響，不是對方的失誤。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Sorry to chase, but I'm a bit stuck without it.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: The client needs it by Thursday, so I'd need it by Wednesday.
scenes.meaning: 客戶星期四要，所以我星期三需要拿到
scenes.note: by ＋ 時間 ＝ 最晚……之前

lines.say: Explain the chain. Show where the deadline comes from.
lines.zh: 說明環環相扣的關係，讓對方知道期限從哪來。

lines.say: The client needs it by Thursday, so I'd need it by Wednesday.
When people see the real deadline, it stops feeling like your personal opinion.
lines.zh: 對方看到真正的期限，就不會覺得是你個人在逼他。

lines.say: And give your date a day early. Things always take longer.
lines.zh: 你要的日期提早一天。事情總是比預期久。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: The client needs it by Thursday, so I'd need it by Wednesday.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: Would it help if I took the first section off your hands?
scenes.meaning: 如果第一部分我來幫你處理，會有幫助嗎？
scenes.note: take something off your hands ＝ 幫你接手

lines.say: And here's the clever move: offer help.
lines.zh: 這裡有一招聰明的：主動幫忙。

lines.say: Would it help if I took the first section off your hands?
Take something off your hands means do it for you, so you have less work.
lines.zh: take something off your hands 是幫你接手，讓你少一點工作。

lines.say: Often the delay is because they're overloaded. Help is faster than pressure.
lines.zh: 延誤常常是因為對方太忙。幫忙比施壓更快。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Would it help if I took the first section off your hands?
Let's go back to that morning, the better way.
lines.zh: 我們回到那天早上，用更好的方式。

lines.say: Morning, Arjun! Just checking in on the report. How's it going?
lines.zh: 早安，Arjun！只是來問一下報告，進行得怎麼樣？

lines.say: Honestly? Slowly. I've had three other urgent things this week.
lines.zh: 老實說？很慢。我這週還有三件急事。

lines.say: Sorry to chase, but the client needs it by Thursday, so I'd need it by Wednesday. Would it help if I took the first section off your hands?
lines.zh: 抱歉一直催，但客戶星期四要，所以我星期三需要拿到。如果第一部分我來幫你處理，會有幫助嗎？

lines.say: That would be amazing. Thank you!
lines.zh: 那就太好了，謝謝你！

lines.say: Same report, same deadline, and now he's grateful.
lines.zh: 同一份報告、同一個期限，現在他還謝謝我。

scenes.title: In writing
scenes.sub: 用 email 追：簡短、清楚、好回覆

lines.say: Part three: in writing.
lines.zh: 第三段：用文字追。

lines.say: Most chasing happens in email or chat. These sentences work in both.
lines.zh: 大部分的催促都發生在 email 或聊天訊息裡。這幾句兩種都能用。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Just following up on my email from Monday.
scenes.meaning: 跟進一下我星期一寄的信

lines.say: Just following up on my email from Monday.
Follow up on means contact someone again about the same thing.
lines.zh: follow up on 是針對同一件事再聯絡一次。

lines.say: Say which email. Busy people get a hundred a day.
lines.zh: 說清楚是哪一封，忙的人一天收一百封。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Just following up on my email from Monday.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: Could you let me know either way, so I can plan around it?
scenes.meaning: 不管可不可以，能不能跟我說一聲，我好安排？

lines.say: Sometimes silence is the problem. Ask for any answer.
lines.zh: 有時候問題是沒有回音。那就要求任何答案都好。

lines.say: Could you let me know either way, so I can plan around it?
Either way means yes or no, I just need to know.
lines.zh: either way 是 yes 或 no 都可以，我只是需要知道。

lines.say: Plan around it means organise my work based on the answer.
lines.zh: plan around it 是根據答案來安排我的工作。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Could you let me know either way, so I can plan around it?

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: I've attached the template, so it should only take ten minutes.
scenes.meaning: 我附上了範本，應該只要十分鐘

lines.say: And make it as easy as possible to say yes.
lines.zh: 讓對方盡量容易答應。

lines.say: I've attached the template, so it should only take ten minutes.
When a task looks small, people do it immediately.
lines.zh: 工作看起來很小，對方就會馬上做。

lines.say: Ten minutes is a promise. Make sure it's true!
lines.zh: 十分鐘是個承諾，要確定是真的！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've attached the template, so it should only take ten minutes.

scenes.title: Escalate
scenes.sub: 往上找：最後一步，還是要客氣

lines.say: Part four: when nothing works.
lines.zh: 第四段：怎麼樣都沒用的時候。

lines.say: Sometimes you have to involve a manager. Do it openly, never behind someone's back.
lines.zh: 有時候得找主管。要光明正大，千萬不要在背後說。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: I don't want to go over your head, but this is holding up the whole project.
scenes.meaning: 我不想越級找你主管，但這卡住了整個專案
scenes.note: go over someone's head ＝ 越級　hold up ＝ 拖延

lines.say: I don't want to go over your head, but this is holding up the whole project.
Go over someone's head means talk to their boss instead of them.
lines.zh: go over someone's head 是越過他直接找他主管。

lines.say: Holding up means delaying. You're explaining the stakes, not making a threat.
lines.zh: holding up 是拖累。你是在說明利害，不是威脅。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I don't want to go over your head, but this is holding up the whole project.

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: Shall we loop in Valeria to help us prioritise?
scenes.meaning: 要不要把 Valeria 也拉進來，幫我們排優先順序？
scenes.note: loop in ＝ 讓某人加入（討論或 email）

lines.say: Then suggest it together. We, not I.
lines.zh: 然後用「我們」一起提，不是「我」。

lines.say: Shall we loop in Valeria to help us prioritise?
Loop in means add someone to the conversation or email.
lines.zh: loop in 是把某人加進對話或 email。

lines.say: Help us prioritise makes the manager a helper, not a judge.
lines.zh: help us prioritise 讓主管變成幫手，不是法官。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Shall we loop in Valeria to help us prioritise?

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: Thanks for pulling this together. I know it was a lot.
scenes.meaning: 謝謝你把這件事完成，我知道很不容易
scenes.note: pull something together ＝ 把東西整合完成

lines.say: And when it's finally done, say thank you. Properly.
lines.zh: 終於完成時，好好說謝謝。

lines.say: Thanks for pulling this together. I know it was a lot.
Pull something together means organise lots of pieces into one finished thing.
lines.zh: pull something together 是把很多部分整合成一個成品。

lines.say: I know it was a lot shows you saw their effort. Next time, they'll be faster for you.
lines.zh: I know it was a lot 表示你看見他的努力。下次他會更快幫你。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Thanks for pulling this together. I know it was a lot.

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：辦公室裡的兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Two phrases from Irish offices.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！愛爾蘭辦公室常聽到的兩句。

lines.say: When an Irish colleague is very busy, they say this.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭同事很忙時，會這樣說。

lines.say: I'm up to my eyes.
Up to my eyes in work, like water up to your eyes. You can't see anything else!
lines.zh: 工作淹到眼睛，什麼都看不到了！

big: 我等一下就做（其實要很久）

lines.say: And be careful with this one.
lines.zh: 還有這一句要小心。

lines.say: I'll do it in a minute.
In Ireland, a minute can mean ten minutes, an hour, or next week. Ask: what time?
lines.zh: 在愛爾蘭，一分鐘可能是十分鐘、一小時，或下禮拜。記得問：幾點？

lines.say: I'll do it in a minute.

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：追到了，朋友也還在

lines.say: Let's chase Arjun one more time, nicely. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們再好好追一次 Arjun。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Morning! Is there anything you're waiting on from me?
lines.zh: 早安！你有在等我這邊的什麼東西嗎？

lines.say: No, I'm just up to my eyes.
lines.zh: 沒有，我只是忙到不行。

lines.say: No rush, but do you have a rough idea of when it'll be ready?
lines.zh: 不急，但你大概知道什麼時候會好嗎？

lines.say: Wednesday, I promise.
lines.zh: 星期三，我保證。

lines.say: Perfect. Could you let me know either way, so I can plan around it?
lines.zh: 太好了。不管可不可以，能不能跟我說一聲，我好安排？

lines.say: Will do.
lines.zh: 沒問題。

items: Just checking in on the report. How's it going?
No rush, but do you have a rough idea of when it'll be ready?
Is there anything you're waiting on from me?
Sorry to chase, but I'm a bit stuck without it.
The client needs it by Thursday, so I'd need it by Wednesday.
Would it help if I took the first section off your hands?
Just following up on my email from Monday.
Could you let me know either way, so I can plan around it?
I've attached the template, so it should only take ten minutes.
I don't want to go over your head, but this is holding up the whole project.
Shall we loop in Valeria to help us prioritise?
Thanks for pulling this together. I know it was a lot.

lines.say: Report done, friendship saved. Brilliant!
lines.zh: 報告完成，友誼保住。太棒了！

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them before you send your next reminder.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡，下次催人之前先截圖。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: Just following up: did you subscribe? No rush! Bye!
lines.zh: 跟進一下：你訂閱了嗎？不急！Bye！
